title: MinIO
description: S3-compatible object storage (Silo, the maintained MinIO fork) on a Volume of the project, with a generated root password and the S3 API on a public hostname.

parameters.label: App name
parameters.hint: Also its hostname in the project. The Volume is <name>-data.

parameters.label: S3 API hostname
parameters.hint: Leave empty to keep the S3 API inside the cluster.

parameters.label: Console hostname
parameters.hint: The web console. Leave empty to keep it inside the cluster.

parameters.label: Apps that may connect
parameters.hint: Apps of the cluster that use the S3 API from inside (api, or shop/api).

title: n8n
description: The n8n workflow automation tool on a public hostname, with its own PostgreSQL. The database password and n8n's encryption key are generated.

parameters.label: App name
parameters.hint: The database is <name>-db; the secret set <name>.

parameters.label: Hostname
parameters.hint: n8n's editor and webhooks are served here over HTTPS.

parameters.label: Time zone
parameters.hint: For schedule triggers, like Europe/Berlin or UTC.

title: Plausible Analytics
description: Privacy-friendly web analytics (Plausible Community Edition) on a public hostname, with its PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. All passwords and the secret key base are generated.

parameters.label: App name
parameters.hint: The databases are <name>-db and <name>-events; the secret set <name>.

parameters.label: Hostname
parameters.hint: Plausible's dashboard and its script are served here over HTTPS.

parameters.label: Registration
parameters.hint: invite_only lets the first user register, then only invited ones; true disables it, false leaves it open.

title: PostgreSQL
description: A PostgreSQL 18 server with a disk of its own. Its password is generated; other apps connect with the DATABASE_URL key of its secret set.

parameters.label: App name
parameters.hint: Also its hostname in the project, and the name of its secret set.

parameters.label: Disk
parameters.hint: local-nvme disks cannot grow later; hcloud-volume disks can.

parameters.label: Apps that may connect
parameters.hint: Apps of this project (api) or of others (shop/api). You can change this in the app's settings later.

title: Redis
description: A Redis 8 server with a generated password, persisting to a disk of its own. Other apps connect with the REDIS_URL key of its secret set.

parameters.label: App name
parameters.hint: Also its hostname in the project, and the name of its secret set.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.hint: Redis keeps its data in memory; small holds about 200 MiB.

parameters.label: Apps that may connect
parameters.hint: Apps of this project (api) or of others (shop/api).
